newsitem.title: USA: Rattigan names team to unseat RJR directors.
newsitem.headline: Rattigan names team to unseat RJR directors.

text.p: Thomas Rattigan named a team of advisors Monday to further his goal of electing a new board of directors at RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp this spring.
Rattigan is allied with Carl Icahn, RJR's largest individual shareholder.

The advisory team consists of investment banker Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette; the law firms of Kaye, Scholer, Fierman, Hays & Handler, and Gordon Altman Butowsky Fierman, Hays & Handler, and Gordon Altman Butowsky Weitzen Shalov & Wein; Georgeson & Co, which will solicit proxies; and The Abernathy MacGregor Group Inc, which will provide financial public relations and investor relations counsel.

"As we prepare to file our proxy, it was important that we have a first- class team of advisors to counsel us on the numerous issues that will arise in our plan to unseat the RJR Board of Directors," said Rattigan, who heads one slate of directors being nominated to RJR's board.
A second slate of directors, backed by Bennett LeBow, chairman of the Brooke Group Ltd, will also put up a slate of nominees for the RJR board.
NEW YORK, Feb 3 (Reuter) - Thomas Rattigan named a team of advisors Monday to further his goal of electing a new board of directors at RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp this spring.
Rattigan is allied with Carl Icahn, RJR's largest individual shareholder.

The advisory team consists of investment banker Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette; the law firms of Kaye, Scholer, Fierman, Hays & Handler, and Gordon Altman Butowsky Weitzen Shalov & Wein; Georgeson & Co, which will solicit proxies; and The Abernathy MacGregor Group Inc, which will provide financial public relations and investor relations counsel.

"As we prepare to file our proxy, it was important that we have a first-class team of advisors to counsel us on the number of issues that will arise in our plan to unseat the RJR board of directors," said Rattigan, who heads one slate of directors being nominated to RJR's board.
Bennett LeBow, chairman of the Brooke Group Ltd has also reserved the right to put up a slate of nominees for the RJR board.
